title: David and Bathsheba

questions.question: At what time of year did kings go out to battle?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 11:1 (ESV): "In the spring of the year, the time when kings go out to battle..."

questions.question: Who did David send to ravage the Ammonites while he stayed in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 11:1 (ESV): "...David sent Joab... But David remained at Jerusalem."

questions.question: Who was the woman David saw bathing?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 11:3 (ESV): "...Is not this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam..."

questions.question: Who was Bathsheba's husband?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 11:3 (ESV): "...the wife of Uriah the Hittite?"

questions.question: Why did David want Uriah to go home?
options: To wash his feet (sleep with his wife)
questions.correctAnswer: To wash his feet (sleep with his wife)
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 11:8 (ESV): "Then David said to Uriah, 'Go down to your house and wash your feet.'"

questions.question: Why did Uriah refuse to go to his house?
options: Because the ark and Israel and Judah dwell in booths
questions.correctAnswer: Because the ark and Israel and Judah dwell in booths
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 11:11 (ESV): "The ark and Israel and Judah dwell in booths... Shall I then go to my house to eat and to drink and to lie with my wife?"

questions.question: What did David do to Uriah on the second night to try and make him go home?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 11:13 (ESV): "...and he made him drunk. And in the evening he went out to lie on his couch... but he did not go down to his house."

questions.question: How did David arrange for Uriah to die?
options: Set him in the forefront of the hardest fighting and draw back
questions.correctAnswer: Set him in the forefront of the hardest fighting and draw back
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 11:15 (ESV): "...Set Uriah in the forefront of the hardest fighting, and then draw back from him..."

questions.question: Who carried the letter containing his own death sentence?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 11:14 (ESV): "...David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah."

questions.question: Who was Bathsheba the daughter of?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 11:3 (ESV): "...Is not this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam..."

questions.question: How did the Lord feel about what David had done?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 11:27 (ESV): "But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD."

questions.question: Who else died with Uriah?
options: Some of the servants of David
questions.correctAnswer: Some of the servants of David
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 11:17 (ESV): "Some of the servants of David among the people fell. Uriah the Hittite also died."

questions.question: Who was the name of the man who killed Abimelech son of Jerubbesheth (mentioned by Joab)?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 11:21 (ESV): "Who killed Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Did not a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall...?"

questions.question: Where did the fighting take place where Uriah died?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 11:1 (ESV): "...and besieged Rabbah." (Context of the war).

questions.question: David told the messenger to say to Joab, "Do not let this matter ______ you, for the sword devours now one and now another."
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 11:25 (ESV): "David said to the messenger... 'Do not let this matter displease you, for the sword devours now one and now another.'"

key_verse_text: And when the mourning was over, David sent and brought her to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD. (ESV)
